trigger: P0579 found that the externally locked inverse-derived endpoint kernel improved both raw clusters, while the calibration-selected flexible route overfit. The earlier SPARC arc-apogee test added a scalar enhancement; this stage instead tests the stricter claim that routing alone redistributes a fixed baryonic gravity budget.
question: Can the same extent-gated conservative return kernels used in P0579 improve galaxy rotation curves without adding integrated gravitational source strength?

radial_translation.force_equivalent_mass: M_b(<r)=g_b(r)*r^2/G, monotonized over the measured profile
radial_translation.shells: Delta M_b are the positive increments of the force-equivalent cumulative mass
radial_translation.endpoint: each shell launched at r is deposited at |r-lambda*R80|
radial_translation.chord: each shell is deposited uniformly along |r-t*lambda*R80|
radial_translation.radial_arc_0.5: the chord receives an outward radial bow 0.5*R80*4t(1-t)
radial_translation.width: the routed radial residence density is Gaussian-smoothed by eta*R80 and renormalized
radial_translation.conservation: Every routed shell profile is renormalized to the original total force-equivalent baryonic mass; no scalar q greater than one is fitted.

candidate_source.policy: Evaluate all already-frozen P0579 candidates. No route parameter is selected or fitted on SPARC before scores.

galaxy_test.nuisance_policy: Reuse the fixed-RAR distance, inclination, disk M/L, and bulge M/L values so formula response is compared on identical adjusted points.

controls.fixed_RAR: saved fixed-RAR prediction with the same nuisances
controls.arc_apogee_R1322: the prior non-conservative scalar return law, for diagnostic context only

claim_limits: M_b(<r)=g_b*r^2/G is a spherical force-equivalent representation of disk, gas, and bulge forces, not a literal three-dimensional mass reconstruction.
Radial Gaussian residence is the one-dimensional analogue of the two-dimensional cluster kernel; vertical disk structure is not represented.
The same fixed-RAR nuisances are reused to isolate formula response and do not constitute an independent likelihood fit for the return law.
All 432 candidate rankings on SPARC are exploratory; only K0338 and K0107 were fixed without SPARC scores.
Conservative redistribution cannot increase the force outside a surface enclosing the entire routed source, which is a deliberate falsifiable restriction.
